def split_csv(line):
    """Split one CSV line into fields, honouring double-quoted fields.

    Inside a quoted field, commas are literal and a doubled quote ("")
    represents a single quote character. The surrounding quotes are not
    part of the field value.
    """
    fields = []
    field = []
    in_quotes = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(line):
        char = line[i]
        if char == '"':
            if in_quotes and i + 1 < len(line) and line[i + 1] == '"':
                field.append('"')
                i += 2
                continue
            in_quotes = not in_quotes
        elif char == ',' and not in_quotes:
            fields.append(''.join(field))
            field = []
        else:
            field.append(char)
        i += 1
    fields.append(''.join(field))
    return fields
